version: Gemini app, personal accounts without a Google AI plan
genus: Google's AI chat app, free plan
free_tier: Auto picks the model: mostly Flash-Lite; choosing yourself gives Flash-Lite only
test: Desk study: Google's help article on the 9 Oct 2026 change, compared with press reports.
verdict_reason: Free Gemini still works, and Auto may still hand a hard question to Pro, but you can no longer pick Pro or Flash yourself. Most people can stay free; heavy users who want Pro need the $19.99 plan, because the $4.99 plan loses Pro too.
lesson: Read the company's own page before the headlines: free Gemini didn't lose Pro completely, it lost your choice of model.

successors.line: Hard questions may still get Pro

sources.label: Google: Changes to Gemini model access and limits
